carrier_force.secondary_carriers: Junyo/Hiyo/Ryujo/Zuiho remain 90-130 nmi-class rear depth centered; used for recovery/CAP relay, not added to first strike.

contact_chain.event: Carrier track decays; Combined Fleet declines another mass land-based night torpedo raid and preserves scouts/attack crews for confirmation.
Four-carrier force launches a ten-aircraft pre-dawn fan search while closing under EMCON.
One scout reacquires TG58.2-class three-deck/three-BB group about 235-270 nmi ESE, with launch/recovery activity visible; position error about 10-15 nmi.
Second scout visually places another fast-carrier group about 150-190 nmi N/NE of the primary target; third group remains sector-level only.
GO opens: fresh target, visible mission split, acceptable launch/recovery range, westward egress, and non-merged other-TG geometry.

Japanese_strike.US_warning: US radar/CIC obtains roughly 85-105 nmi warning and stages heavy F6F CAP; neighboring fighters reinforce at the engagement edge.

centered_damage.Cabot_CVL28: One aerial torpedo hit centered. Heavy current-campaign mission kill; survives and withdraws for repair assessment.
centered_damage.Intrepid_CV11: One bomb hit plus splinter damage centered. Flight-deck cycle interrupted about 5-8 h; propulsion retained.
centered_damage.Essex_CV9: Near-miss/splinter/light damage only centered; no mission kill.

anti_overreach: Fourth Japanese deck thickens the strike but does not erase US radar/CIC/F6F/AA superiority.
Kinsei Zero improves escort choice/survival but does not inflate range or make the entire fighter force Kinsei-equipped.
